name: Vera Blanc and the Crescent City Mystery
source:
Take on the role of Vera Blanc, a beautiful young woman with the extraordinary ability to read other people's minds!
Daughter of Emmanuel Blanc, Vera left a life of luxury to work alongside paranormal detective Brandon Mackey.
In this game Vera Blanc and her partner Brandon Mackey travel to New Orleans to investigate a case of Stalking. 
Will you be able to solve the mystery?

Vera Blanc immerses you in the world of the supernatural as you play the detective!
The game ending you get depends on choices you make. Game play includes a challenging mini-game.

[From [url=http://wolflore.net/viewtopic.php?f=37&t=1429]Wolflore[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演维拉·布朗克——一名拥有读心这一非凡能力的美丽年轻女子！
维拉是伊曼纽尔 布朗克的女儿。她放弃奢华生活，与超自然侦探布兰登·麦基并肩工作。
在本作中，维拉·布朗克和搭档布兰登·麦基前往新奥尔良，调查一起跟踪案件。
你能解开这个谜团吗？

扮演侦探的你将通过维拉·布朗克沉浸在超自然世界之中！
你得到的游戏结局取决于自己的选择。游戏中还包含一个颇具挑战性的小游戏。

[译自[url=http://wolflore.net/viewtopic.php?f=37&t=1429]Wolflore[/url]]
